description: Read a saved organization template by id or a known public catalog template by slug. Use the returned document and exact reference to inspect required media parameters, presets, brand kit and rubric before start_template or apply_template. Do not invent a slug from a component-library card.
name: get_template

document.description: A CueFrame template document (kernel TemplateDocument): v: 1, slug, name, composition with {{name}} references, parameters, components by value, an optional brandKit, presets, rubric, gallery and provenance.

title: Get Template
